Welch and Goyal (2008) s.1: CPI-U from BLS, 'released only in the following month'. Usable from the first of the month after that, which waits out a release later in the following month (BLS normally publishes mid-month). One known miss: BLS published no October 2025 CPI (shutdown); the workbook's October value interpolates the index linearly between September and November (the two monthly changes differ by exactly the ratio that implies, measured 2026-10-15), and the November release came on 2025-12-18, so knowledge dates 2025-12-01 to 2025-12-17 see it early.
